meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: Claude 把新版本号写进八个清单文件（package.json 等），再跑构建、提交推送、打 git tag、建 GitHub release、重新生成 CHANGELOG；npm 发布留给你手动执行。
howto.when: 当你要给 Claude Code 插件发新版本、并已确定是 PATCH、MINOR 还是 MAJOR 升级时接管，从改版本号一直做到 GitHub release 和 changelog。

say.text: 帮我把版本从 1.2.0 升到 1.2.1，走完整发布流程
say.note: 它会改八个清单文件并提交、打 tag

say.text: 这次是修 bug，按 PATCH 升版并建 GitHub release
say.note: 会补上发布说明并推送

say.text: 发布完成后重新生成 CHANGELOG 并推送
say.note: 跑项目里的 changelog 脚本

howto.what_en: Claude writes the new version into all eight manifest files, runs the build, commits and pushes, creates the git tag and GitHub release, and regenerates the changelog. It stops before npm publish and hands that final step to you.
howto.when_en: Use when you are releasing a new version of a Claude Code plugin and have settled on a PATCH, MINOR, or MAJOR bump; it takes over from the version edits through the GitHub release and changelog.

say_en.text: Bump the version from 1.2.0 to 1.2.1 and run the full release flow
This is a bug fix, so do a PATCH bump and create the GitHub release
After publishing, regenerate the CHANGELOG and push it
